name: LinkMaster
author: Codeace

sections.description:
The Dynamic Custom Permalink Handler allows WordPress site administrators to easily define custom permalinks for individual posts and pages directly from the post edit screen. This can be particularly useful for creating SEO-friendly URLs or organizing content without changing the site’s overall URL structure.

Features include:
– Define custom permalinks for any post or page.
– Now you can include ‘?’ in your URLs.
– Seamless integration with WordPress’s existing permalink structure.
– No need to modify .htaccess or server configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the post edit screen to set custom permalinks for posts and pages.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin for custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports custom permalinks for posts and pages only. Support for custom post types is planned for future releases. Please check for updates if you require this feature.

What happens to existing permalinks if I deactivate the plugin?

Existing permalinks will revert to the default WordPress permalink structure. Custom permalinks set via the plugin will not function until the plugin is reactivated.

Is it necessary to modify server settings or .htaccess files?

No, there are no server or .htaccess modifications required. The plugin handles permalinks dynamically within WordPress’s framework.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release. Support for adding custom permalinks via the WordPress admin panel for posts and pages.
